## Triage: first grade, `domain:ui` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T22:54Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 (the filer's):** six serial request waves stand before the first paint. It is the critical-path half of cloud#2914 (p1).
- **For the claimant:** Parallelize what does not depend on the organisation chain, and move the metadata preload off the splash path. Serial with objectui#12808 (same open path); the same seat can take both.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p1`; filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat as the critical-path half of objectstack-ai/cloud#2914, the 13 s console open, and graded by the triage seat, `6226217769`; serial after objectui#12808, which landed as `5d69b0e`)
Session: `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12809-splash-critical-path`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12809` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface: `packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx` and `packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` (the organisation chain: the active organisation from `session.activeOrganizationId` and the list answer, the member row in parallel), `packages/auth/src/useWorkspaceAdminStatus.ts` (only if the splash gate's `me/permissions` wave moves), `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (the splash gate and its metadata preload), the route components under `packages/app-shell/src/console/` that read a metadata bucket at render and so must wait on their own type (each named in the report), tests beside each, one `.changeset/12809-*.md` per released package touched. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` stays out of bounds. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: `@object-ui/auth` exports `useAuth`'s context and `useWorkspaceAdminStatus`; when the active organisation and the member row resolve may change what those values read during boot. «拿不准 ⇒ 按 yes». The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review comes before ready.
Responsibility: n/a — measured serial request waves on every console open
Thread-read: 6226217769
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12808 (the same boot path) landed as `5d69b0e`. No open objectui PR touches `AuthProvider.tsx`, `createAuthClient.ts` or `AppContent.tsx` (read at dispatch). The server-side query count of `get-full-organization` (9 serial queries) is a framework card and not this one.
